defect.observed: buildFallbackItemsBreakdown() rebuilds one row per scout item and buildCreateSkipResponse() rebuilds one row per preCalculated item; neither copies boundingBox2D, so on those routes every dish reaches the ledger with no box, while the non-fallback path keeps it.
